card.name: Boxed warning headings in capitals
card.fires_on: The end of SERIOUS (the IOUS piece) or the word AND inside all-caps boxed warning titles, such as SERIOUS INFECTIONS or CARDIOVASCULAR AND GASTROINTESTINAL EVENTS. It also appears on AND in an all-caps heading in non-drug text.

modes.label: SERIOUS in warning title
modes.description: The final piece of SERIOUS right after WARNING: in a capitalized boxed warning heading.

modes.label: AND in capitalized heading
modes.description: The word AND joining two capitalized terms in a heading.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR<< AND>> GASTROINTESTINAL EVENTS

card.writes: The promoted tokens are word starts of verbs and nouns (heal, observ, remodel, react), with no clear link to the heading text.
card.plain: It lights up inside the all-caps boxed warning titles, on SERIOUS or on AND between two listed risks.
